Bill.BriefDescription: Designating the Siberian husky as the official state dog.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the state dog; and adding a new section tochapter 1.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The Siberian husky is hereby designated as the official dog of thestate of Washington.
